According to the method, targets are designed for exon regions of a corn ZmBADH2-1 gene and a ZmBADH2-2 gene and a CRISPR/Cas9 gene editing carrier is constructed, and a double-gene knockout mutant is obtained through genetic transformation. Experiments prove that in grains of four T1-generation double-gene knockout mutants, the highest content of 2-AP is 438.29 [mu]g.kg <-1>, the lowest content of the 2-AP is 161.82 [mu]g.kg <-1>, and the 2-AP is not detected in Jing 724 which is not edited. According to the method, the aroma trait of the corn is directionally improved efficiently from a molecular genetics level by using a CRISPR/Cas9 technology, new germplasms of backbone parents of corn with different aroma gradients is efficiently created, and a new breeding material is provided for development of an aromatic corn variety and improvement of the taste quality of the corn.(ZH) 本发明公开了一种利用CRISPR/Cas9技术高效创制香味玉米的方法。本发明对玉米ZmBADH2‑1基因和ZmBADH2‑2基因的外显子区域设计靶点并构建CRISPR/Cas9基因编辑载体，通过遗传转化获得双基因敲除突变体。通过实验证明：4个T1代双基因敲除突变体的籽粒中，2‑AP含量最高为438.29μg·kg‑1、最低为161.82μg·kg‑1，而未经过编辑的京724中未检测到2‑AP。本发明利用CRISPR/Cas9技术从分子遗传学层面定向、高效地改良玉米香味性状，高效创制出不同香味梯度的玉米骨干亲本新种质，为香型玉米品种的开发和玉米食味品质的提升提供了新的育种材料。",113215156,22.07.2022,,

View less classifications","LANZHOU VETERINARY RESEARCH INSTITUTE, CHINESE ACADEMY OF AGRICULTURE SCIENCES中国农业科学院兰州兽医研究所",HOU SHITONG侯石桐SUN YUEFENG孙跃峰WANG XIANGWEI王相伟YIN XIANGPING殷相平MAO RUOQING毛箬青ZHAO SHUAIYANG赵帅阳,北京兴智翔达知识产权代理有限公司 11768,(EN) HDAC3 gene knockout BHK-21 cell line as well as construction method and application thereof(ZH) HDAC3基因敲除的BHK-21细胞系及其构建方法和应用,,"(EN) The invention discloses a construction method of an HDAC3 gene knockout BHK-21 cell line, which comprises the following steps: carrying out gene knockout on HDAC3 in a cell line BHK-21 for foot-and-mouth disease vaccine production by utilizing a CRISPR/Cas9 technology, transfecting BHK-21 cells by utilizing CRISPR plasmids for knocking out the HDAC3, and separating the cells to obtain a plurality of cell clones by utilizing antibiotic screening in combination with gradient dilution and a cloning ring method; extracting the genome DNA, performing PCR amplification and sequencing, and successfully identifying the cell clones of which two HDAC3 genes are subjected to homozygous frameshift mutation. In the HDAC3 knockout BHK-21 cell line, the replication rate of foot-and-mouth disease virus is obviously accelerated, the final virus titer is obviously improved, and the HDAC3 knockout has no obvious influence on the cell growth rate, so that the HDAC3 knockout BHK-21 cell line has the prospect of being used for foot-and-mouth disease vaccine production. Therefore, the foundation is laid for further knocking out HDAC3 from suspension culture type BHK-21 cells and directly applying HDAC3 to foot-and-mouth disease vaccine production.(ZH) 本发明公开了HDAC3基因敲除的BHK‑21细胞系的构建方法，利用CRISPR/Cas9技术对口蹄疫疫苗生产用细胞系BHK‑21中的HDAC3进行基因敲除，将用于敲除HDAC3的CRISPR质粒转染BHK‑21细胞后，利用抗生素筛选结合梯度稀释，用克隆环法分离到了多个细胞克隆。提取基因组DNA后进行PCR扩增、测序，成功鉴定到了2个HDAC3基因发生纯合移码突变的细胞克隆。HDAC3敲除的BHK‑21细胞系中口蹄病毒复制速率明显加快，最终病毒滴度有显著提高，且HDAC3敲除后对细胞生长速率无显著影响，说明其有用于口蹄疫疫苗生产的前景。为进一步在悬浮培养型BHK‑21细胞中敲除HDAC3，直接用于口蹄疫疫苗生产奠定了基础。",112852745,23.05.2023,,

View less classifications","NANFAN SEED INSTITUTE, GUANGDONG ACADEMY OF SCIENCES广东省科学院南繁种业研究所",GUO YUQIANG郭育强WANG QINNAN王勤南LIU ZHUANG刘壮ZHANG WEI张伟CHANG HAILONG常海龙QIN YUANXIA秦元霞,广东南北知识产权代理事务所(普通合伙) 44918,(EN) Sugarcane parthenogenesis haploid induction gene SaMTL and application thereof(ZH) 甘蔗孤雌生殖单倍体诱导基因SaMTL及其应用,,"(EN) The invention belongs to the technical field of crop genetic engineering, and particularly relates to a sugarcane parthenogenesis haploid induction gene SaMTL and application thereof. View less classifications",RICE RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF GUANGDONG ACADEMY OF AGRICULTURAL SCIENCES广东省农业科学院水稻研究所,MAO XINGXUE毛兴学LIU BIN刘斌WANG FENG王丰ZHANG JIANJUN张建军LIU WUGE柳武革,广州容大知识产权代理事务所(普通合伙) 44326,(EN) Paddy rice seed dormancy controlling gene OsMPK7 and applications thereof(ZH) 水稻种子休眠性调控基因OsMPK7及其应用,,"(EN) The invention discloses a paddy rice seed dormancy controlling gene OsMPK7 and applications thereof, and belongs to the technical fields of biological technology and crop gene engineering. The disclosed paddy rice seed dormancy controlling gene OsMPK7 plays an important role in improving the paddy rice seed dormancy. The sequence of the gene OsMPK7 is represented by SEQ ID No.2.
